Twitter is a social network and a news media, with a strong influence of the latter.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Twitter is not a social network, but a news media with a social networking component.

Twitter is not just another social network but is an emerging news medium that can reach a large population of users within minutes.

Twitter is a new media that is different from traditional news media in its ability of fast and wide information dissemination.
